name: markdown-html
description: Export Markdown (.md) to self-contained .md.html files with GitHub Alerts, KaTeX math, and a built-in rendered viewer.

enumDescriptions: Automatically update <file>.md.html on save only if <file>.md.html already exists next to the Markdown file.
Always create or update <file>.md.html whenever a Markdown file is saved.
Only export manually via the 'Markdown HTML: Export (.md.html)' command.
markdown-html.convertOnSave.description: Control automatic .md.html export when saving a Markdown (.md) file.

markdown-html.convertOnSaveExclude.description: Regex patterns for filenames excluded from convertOnSave.

markdown-html.styles.description: Local paths or URLs to CSS stylesheets to inline into the exported .md.html file.

markdown-html.stylesRelativePathFile.description: Interpret relative paths in markdown-html.styles as relative to the Markdown file.

markdown-html.includeDefaultStyles.description: When neither 'markdown.styles' nor 'markdown-html.styles' is set, automatically inline the bundled VS Code Light/Dark 2026 stylesheet matching the active VS Code color theme.

markdown-html.outputDirectory.description: Optional output directory for exported .md.html files.

markdown-html.outputDirectoryRelativePat.description: Interpret relative markdown-html.outputDirectory paths as relative to the Markdown file.

markdown-html.sanitize.description: Sanitize raw HTML in Markdown per GitHub Flavored Markdown.

markdown-html.highlight.description: Enable syntax highlighting for fenced code blocks.

markdown-html.highlightStyle.description: Optional highlight.js stylesheet filename (defaults to tomorrow.css).

markdown-html.breaks.description:
Convert single newlines in paragraphs into
tags.

markdown-html.mermaidServer.description: Mermaid script URL (loaded only when the document contains a ```mermaid block).

markdown-html.math.enabled.description: Enable KaTeX math rendering for $...$, $$...$$, \(...\), \[...\], and ```math fenced blocks.

markdown-html.math.katex.macros.markdownDescription: User-defined KaTeX macros passed to the KaTeX renderer.

markdown-html.StatusbarMessageTimeout.description: Status bar message timeout in milliseconds.
